design: Select four previously unused neighborhoods and new calendar year before reading their imagery. Same 600 m UTM square definition as ordinary-city-2021-v1, 36 cells each. Census January, April, July, October 2024, the first month of each quarter. No substitutions. Scope restricted to these 16 plot-months, 576 cell-months.
inputs: All default observation sources at the frozen commit: Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, Landsat 8, Landsat 9 and historical Open Buildings Temporal. The annual building context cannot itself trigger confirmation. Identical frozen production detector, default config, monthly prospective queries. Request history from 2019-01-01 through the end of each monitored month, with detector's five-year lookback enforced. Never supply post-cutoff data to fitting or confirmation. Resolved source failures must be retried; report as incomplete if unresolved.
endpoints: Per site and pooled, count full support (any channel marked observed) and by channel family including water/vegetation, radar, confirmed cells, candidate-only cells, confirmations from partial coverage and indicators by source/signal. Report confirmed cell-months per 0.36 square km plot-month. No extrapolation to whole cities. These are signal notifications projected at historical cutoff; true alert latency cannot be inferred from retrospective archives. No independent labels for physical false-alert rates or precision in this cohort. No release gate.
comparison: This is a default-configuration burden study using disjoint sites and months, not a sensor ablation on the 2021 JRC study.
